title_en: Star Wars: Galactic Racers Is Free to Play on Amazon Luna, Which Comes Free with Every Prime Membership
summary_en: Star Wars: Galactic Racers is free to play on Amazon Luna, the game streaming service that comes free with every Prime membership.
body_en:
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is the first podracing game to release in over two decades. It features all sorts of zippy vehicles from a galaxy far, far away, vying for speed supremacy in a variety of diverse locations. The vehicles are highly customizable, and you can collect them all as you make your way through the roguelite-inspired racing campaign.
In racing expert Luke Reilly ’s very positive IGN review , he wrote, “Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a fabulous looking and frantically fast anti-grav racer that gets a little repetitive thanks to its heavy reliance on repeatedly revisiting the same slim selection of planets, but has successfully lit the afterburners on a long-dormant slice of the Star Wars universe.”
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is out today, October 6, on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Amazon Luna. If you don’t have a Prime subscription and, by gum, you’re not going to get one now, you can buy one of the three available editions at a variety of retailers. PC gamers can even get a discount on a Steam code at Fanatical by entering promo code FANATICAL15 at checkout.
If you picked up a Prime membership, or you’re already one, you can take advantage of the many deals available in Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days sale , running now through October 7. It has deep discounts on items like video games , as well as LEGO sets and Apple products and 4K Blu-rays . Basically, if you want to buy something, you can probably find it on sale — assuming you’re a Prime member.
